text_markup: The Runner plays {card:Tinkering} on a {card:Lycan} hosting 1 advancement counter. {card:Lycan} has two instances of {subtype:sentry}, one printed and one from {card:Tinkering}, and has lost one instance of {subtype:sentry} from its own ability. Thus it is still a {subtype:sentry}.
text_plain: The Runner plays Tinkering on a Lycan hosting 1 advancement counter. Lycan has two instances of sentry, one printed and one from Tinkering, and has lost one instance of sentry from its own ability. Thus it is still a sentry.
